chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked, 'A man who was performing Tamattu' and declared the intention for Hajj.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He should not perform Tawaf by the House until he goes to Arafat. So if he performs Tawaf before he goes to Mina without a valid reason, then he will not be counted with that Tawaf.'

key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: Arafat, the essential station of Hajj
key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعاً: One performing Hajj al-Tamattu' (combining Umrah and Hajj)
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the tent city near Mecca

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Tawaf before going to Mina for a Mu'tamir?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the ruling for a Mu'tamir who performs Tawaf al-Qudum before reaching Mina, ruling that it is not counted as the obligatory Tawaf unless there is a valid excuse (ʿudhr). This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the strict chronological sequence of Hajj rites, distinguishing between the optional arrival circumambulation and the essential Tawaf al-Ziyarah performed after standing at Arafat.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said, ‘A man who was a performer of Tumatto, and began with the Hajj. Heasws said: ‘He should not perform Tawaaf by the House (Kabah) until he goes to Arafaat. So when he performs Tawaaf before he goes to Mina from other than a (valid) reason, so he would not be counted with that Tawaaf’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Isma‘il ibn Marrar from Yunus from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who is for al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) and has said Talbiyah for al-Hajj. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must not perform Tawaf until he attends ‘Arafah; if he performs Tawaf before attending Mina’ without illness, that Tawaf is not counted.’”
